title: AI and Independent Work in 7 Charts - by Liya Palagashvili
evidence_basis: Retrieved by Exa and preflighted with HTTP 200; evidence stored in source-acquisition.json.
confirmed_fact: Solo-type business applications in AI-exposed sectors rose 26.8% from Q1 2024 to Q1 2026, compared to flat growth in non-exposed sectors.
interpretation: AI is lowering the minimum scale required to operate a business, enabling individuals to perform tasks that previously required teams or firm-based infrastructure.

title: Why China's universities stopped fighting AI
